parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the user group.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the user group.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user group that you want to delete.
> You can call the [ListUserGroups](~~204509~~) operation to query this parameter.
